arxiv-2109-02055.title: A practical compact source of heralded single photons for simple detection LIDAR
arxiv-2109-02055.creator: Mateusz P. Mrozowski, John Jeffers, Jonathan D. Pritchard
arxiv-2109-02055.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mateusz P. Mrozowski, John Jeffers, Jonathan D. Pritchard. Optical quantum technologies such as quantum sensing, quantum cryptography and quantum computation all utilize properties of non-classical light, such as precise photon-number and entangled photon-pair states, to surpass technologies based on the classical light. A common route for obtaining heralded single photons is spontaneous four-wave mixing in optical fibers, allowing for a well-defined spatial mode, for high efficiency integration into optical fiber networks.

in the Large
N

Abstract

We use the new nilpotent formulation of open-closed string field theory to explore the limit where the number
N
of identical D-branes of the starting background is large. By reformulating the theory in terms of the ’t Hooft coupling
\lambda\coloneqq\kappa N
, where
\kappa
is the string coupling constant, we explicitly see that at large
N
only genus zero vertices with arbitrary number of boundaries survive.

arxiv-2308-03226.title: Investigation of Self-supervised Pre-trained Models for Classification of Voice Quality from Speech and Neck Surface Accelerometer Signals Journal: Computer Speech and Language
arxiv-2308-03226.creator: Sudarsana Reddy Kadiri, Farhad Javanmardi, Paavo Alku
arxiv-2308-03226.description: Abstract Prior studies in the automatic classification of voice quality have mainly studied the use of the acoustic speech signal as input. Recently, a few studies have been carried out by jointly using both speech and neck surface accelerometer (NSA) signals as inputs, and by extracting mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs) and glottal source features.

arxiv-2404-14298.title: Constraints on PDS 70 b and c from the dust continuum emission of the circumplanetary discs considering in situ dust evolution
arxiv-2404-14298.creator: Y. Shibaike, C. Mordasini
arxiv-2404-14298.description: Abstract Context. The young T Tauri star PDS 70 has two gas accreting planets sharing one large gap in a pre-transitional disc. Dust continuum emission from PDS 70 c has been detected by Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) Band 7, considered as the evidence of a circumplanetary disc.

arxiv-2408-04493.title: Classification of qubit cellular automata on hypercubic lattices
arxiv-2408-04493.creator: Andrea Pizzamiglio, Alessandro Bisio, Paolo Perinotti
arxiv-2408-04493.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Andrea Pizzamiglio, Alessandro Bisio, Paolo Perinotti. We classify Quantum Cellular Automata whose cells are qubits , on hypercubic lattices ℤ s \mathbb{Z}^{s} , with the von Neumann neighborhood scheme, in terms of realizability as finite-depth quantum circuits. We show the most general structure of such automata and use its characterisation to simulate a few steps of evolution and evaluate the rate of entanglement production between one cell and its surroundings.

arxiv-2508-03754.title: Generating Synthetic Invoices via Layout-Preserving Content Replacement Thanks: The code for this project is available at: https://github.com/BevinV/Synthetic_Invoice_Generation
arxiv-2508-03754.creator: Bevin V, Ananthakrishnan P V, Ragesh KR, Sanjay M, Vineeth S, Bibin Wilson BEO AI
arxiv-2508-03754.description: Abstract . The performance of machine learning models for automated invoice processing is critically dependent on large-scale, diverse datasets. However, the acquisition of such datasets is often constrained by privacy regulations and the high cost of manual annotation. To address this, we present a novel pipeline for generating high-fidelity, synthetic invoice documents and their corresponding structured data.

arxiv-2508-07439.title: Electroconvection in a Magnetic Field Thanks: MSC Classification: 35Q35, 35R11, 78A25.
arxiv-2508-07439.creator: Elie Abdo, Peter Constantin, Mihaela Ignatova, Quyuan Lin
arxiv-2508-07439.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Elie Abdo, Peter Constantin, Mihaela Ignatova, Quyuan Lin. Electroconvection in a porous medium under a strong transversal magnetic field is described by an active scalar equation for the charge density. The equation has global weak solutions with L ∞ L^{\infty} data. We show that for strong enough magnetic fields, L ∞ L^{\infty} -small solutions are smooth globally in time and they obey surface quasigeostrophic equations in the limit of infinite magnetic field strength.

pmc-13156133.title: Integrated xTB and simplified Tamm–Dancoff analysis of composition-dependent electronic structure in GaInZnP/ZnSeyS1-y core/shell quantum dots with DFT and TDDFPT benchmarking

pmc-13338373.creator: Walid El-Shafai, Ahmad Taher Azar, Samah Alshathri
pmc-13338373.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The rising adoption of cryptocurrencies has been paralleled by the emergence of cryptojacking malware, malicious software that covertly hijacks computing resources for unauthorized cryptocurrency mining. pmc-13582059.title: Associations of Polypharmacy, Diuretics and Antipsychotics with Injurious Falls: A Population-Based Cohort Study
pmc-13582059.creator: Tewodros Yosef, Julie A. Pasco, Monica C. Tembo, Kara B. Anderson, Lana J. Williams, Kara L. Holloway-Kew
pmc-13582059.description: ObjectivePopulation ageing increases multimorbidity, which in turn contributes to polypharmacy, elevating fall risk through drug interactions and adverse effects on cognition or balance. This study aimed to examine the associations of polypharmacy, diuretic and antipsychotic use with injurious falls among older adults.

pmc-13680720.title: Liver histopathological findings and clinical associations in dogs undergoing cholecystectomy for gallbladder mucocele
pmc-13680720.creator: Yoshihiko MURAKAMI, Midori GOTO, ASAKAWA, Takeo MINAMI
pmc-13680720.description: Gallbladder mucocele is frequently associated with concurrent hepatic pathology. However, studies examining the clinical relevance of concurrent liver histopathological findings in this condition remain scarce. This retrospective study evaluated liver histopathological findings in dogs that underwent cholecystectomy with concurrent liver biopsy and investigated their associations with preoperative variables, postoperative alanine aminotransferase (ALT) kinetics, and overall survival.
